description: This file defines the CellAlignment class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for reading XLS files. The class provides static methods to set horizontal and vertical alignments and wrap text properties on Alignment objects, using internal mapping arrays to convert integer codes to alignment constants.

classes.name: CellAlignment
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to set horizontal and vertical alignment and wrap text properties on Alignment objects based on integer codes.

methods.name: horizontal
methods.description: Sets the horizontal alignment of an Alignment object based on an integer code mapping to predefined constants.

methods.name: vertical
methods.description: Sets the vertical alignment of an Alignment object based on an integer code mapping to predefined constants.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Enables or disables the wrap text property on an Alignment object.
